text.p: Leading stories in the Greek financial press:
-- A draft 1997 budget that will cause "a fiscal shock". Turn to a tighter budget under the shadow of austerity budgets elsewhere in the European Union
-- Presumptive taxes to increase. Upward re-adjustments of 30 to 50 percent for yachts and luxury cars
-- Buba member said Southern Europe will not be in the first wave of EMU. Favourable forecasts for the end of the century
-- 282 out of 824 tax breaks will be abolished increasing total taxable income by 700 billion drachmas
-- Retroactive annual pay rise of 9.0 percent to accountants after the decision of arbitration

-- Greek industrialists intervene in favour of long-term procurement agreements between state utilities and local private firms. The OTE telecommunications organisation favours procurements with Greek firms
-- A new EU low inflation record was set in August
